 No. 1 Pick AJ Dybantsa (ankle) to remain sidelined
 Wizards coach Brian Keefe said AJ Dybantsa (ankle) will remain out Friday vs. the Raptors (7 ET, League Pass).
 From NBA.com News Services
 October 22, 2026 5:00 PM Coach Brian Keefe said AJ Dybantsa’s injury is day-to-day and believes he won’t miss much time.
 AJ Dybantsa will remain out as the Wizards host the Raptors on Friday ( 7 ET, League Pass ), head coach Brian Keefe announced today. The 2026 No. 1 pick suffered the injury in the team’s preseason finale.
 Breaking: AJ Dybantsa will miss the Wizards season opener against the Bucks, head coach Brian Keefe announced.
 He will be day-to-day with an ankle injury. pic.twitter.com/ujYJ30rZyz 
 — ESPN (@espn) October 20, 2026 
 Through four preseason games, Dybantsa averaged 12.8 points, 3.8 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.5 steals per game. His most notable performance came against the Pistons, when he recorded 14 points and seven rebounds while showcasing his versatility on both ends of the floor.
 Keefe said Dybantsa’s injury is day-to-day and believes he won’t miss much time.
 NBA.com will have more as this story develops.
